study_title: Feruloyl esterase producing prokaryotes in anaerobic and microaerobic ecosystems
study_description: In this study we applied whole genome shotgun metagenomics and genome binning to screen prokaryotes in anaerobic and microaerobic ecosystems for possession of feruloyl esterase genes.
